notes:
- Sign in on a PC with a six-character PIN instead of a username and password.
  The saved session is encrypted with the PIN, so it is the only way back in on
  that machine; five wrong attempts removes it and asks for the password.
- The login window now puts the caret in the field it is asking for: the
  password when the account is already known, the username otherwise.
- Automatic updates, verified against the release signing key before installing.
